lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Flávia Florêncio Ferreira | Lesson 29 -- Planning the Next Mission
lesson.grammar_point: future forms for a plan: going to (intention), present continuous (fixed arrangement) and will (decision on the spot, offer)

items.situation: Giorgio asks: "What are you going to show the delegation?" Answer with your plan.
tips: two coffee farms and one cheese producer.

items.situation: Say one thing that is already arranged, with a day and a time.
The venue is not available. Decide something now.
tips: Okay, I will call the hotel

items.situation: Giorgio needs the itinerary. Offer to send it.
tips: I will send you the itinerary

items.situation: A visit has to move to another day. Say it politely.
tips: We are going to postpone the visit
to Thursday, if that is okay.

listenings.text: Hello, Flavia, it is Giorgio. Good news about March. Our delegation is going to be bigger than we planned. Six people are coming, not four. We are arriving in São Paulo on Sunday the eighth, and we are flying back on Friday. I have one small problem. Our director has a meeting on Monday morning, so can we start the program on Monday afternoon? Also, please send me the itinerary when it is ready, because I am preparing the briefing for the group next week. Thank you, and talk soon.

After fifteen years organizing international missions, I have one rule. Plan early, confirm everything, and always have a plan B. Three months before, decide what you are going to show your guests. One month before, book the venue and the hotel, and send a short itinerary. One week before, confirm every meeting by phone, not only by email. And on the day, be ready to change. A road will be closed, a producer will be sick, a flight will be late. That is normal. Good organizers do not panic. They say, okay, I will call the other farm, and they keep going.

extra_audio.text: First, I say what we are going to show the delegation. Then, I say what is already arranged, with a day and a time. Next, I explain one problem. After that, I decide something on the spot with will. Finally, I offer to send the itinerary.
